title: Irma NDE 7062
content: January 3, 2013 I died. It turns out that I sprained my ankle while walking holding on to Abe's arm, my husband. We were going to the mall and I had said that I wanted to go pee. While on the floor, Abe tried to get me up but I told him not to do it because the pain in my ankle is so intense that I knew I could not stand up. A few seconds go by and I feel better, I think I can stand up holding on to Abe. Next to us, there is a small food stand with some stools, so Abe asks if I can sit there. I start to get dizzy and ask for water. There is none, so I ask for alcohol. They say no again. I ask for some cool juice because I am very dizzy. Then I lost consciousness. Abe was behind me, so he grabbed me while I was falling so I did not get hurt. Suddenly, I am feeling intense pleasure, that I am happy with my parents and my children. This pleasure is so beautiful, but a strong voice bothers me saying ‘Irma, I am here’. Oh no! It takes me out of my pleasure and I don't like it. ’Irma, answer me’ and I slowly leave my state to come back to reality. I see Abe who is next to me, I was on the floor, he picks me up, he takes me to a bench that surrounds a tree, under the shade, he tells me I was not breathing, that I started to respond to the massage he gave me on my chest like CPR. Then a woman appeared with some water, alcohol and I tell her I am okay, to give it to my husband who looked very pale. She gave us some bread. I stand up with my feel wet. Maybe because the floor had recently been washed I possibly fell on a puddle, I thought. When I entered the shopping mall and went to the bathroom, I did not feel the need to go anymore; my panties were wet and smelled like urine. I guess during my fainting I peed. That has not happened to me the last couple of times I have fainted. This time I relaxed the sphincter, I relaxed as dead people do. From that point on, I have noticed that I have some premonitions, sometimes while dreaming.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Sprained ankle while walking; became dizzy and lost consciousness in/near a mall.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Loss of consciousness with intense pleasure/happiness; heard a strong voice saying 'Irma, I am here' and 'Irma, answer me'; then returned to physical awareness.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Reported intense pleasure/happiness 'with my parents and my children' without describing a distinct otherworldly environment; a 'strong voice' interrupted and prompted return to reality.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “Suddenly, I am feeling intense pleasure, that I am happy with my parents and my children.” / “Irma, I am here” / “Irma, answer me”
